{{< include ../_provenance.qmd >}}

Comparison of two demultiplexing tools — **deMULTIplex2** (pipeline default) and
**HTODemux** (Seurat built-in) — on the raw merged object before any QC filtering.
Use this notebook to assess HTO signal quality, compare assignment rates,
and decide which tool to use in the pipeline.

```{r setup}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(patchwork)
library(targets)

source(file.path("src/R/scrna-seq_utilities.R"))
```

```{r load}
# mpn_raw_stroma has the HTO assay + dm2_class added by flag_qc_metadata().
# mpn_raw_all is pre-QC and lacks dm2_class — do not use it here.
targets::tar_load(mpn_raw_stroma)
targets::tar_load(qc_params)

srt           <- mpn_raw_stroma
hto_features  <- rownames(srt[["HTO"]])
DM2_AVAILABLE <- "dm2_class" %in% colnames(srt@meta.data)
```

```{r normalise-hto}
# CLR normalisation required for ridge plots and pair plots (creates data layer).
# The pipeline uses deMULTIplex2 for assignment (dm2_class column); normalisation
# here is only for visualisation purposes — it does not re-run demultiplexing.
srt <- Seurat::NormalizeData(srt, assay = "HTO",
                              normalization.method = "CLR",
                              margin = 2, verbose = FALSE)
```

---

## 1. HTO count distribution

Raw HTO counts per barcode — check that all HTOs are captured.

```{r hto-totals}
hto_counts         <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(
  SeuratObject::LayerData(srt, assay = "HTO", layer = "counts"))))
hto_counts$total   <- rowSums(hto_counts)

ggplot(hto_counts, aes(x = total)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 80, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(title = "Total HTO counts per cell (log10 scale)",
       x = "Total HTO counts", y = "# cells") +
  theme_bw()
```

---

## 2. HTO CLR-normalised signal per assignment class

Ridge plots of CLR-normalised HTO signal grouped by deMULTIplex2 class.
Good separation between positive and negative peaks indicates clean demultiplexing.

```{r hto-ridge}
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(get0("DM2_AVAILABLE"))
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 6
Seurat::Idents(srt) <- "dm2_class"
Seurat::RidgePlot(srt,
                  assay    = "HTO",
                  features = hto_features,
                  ncol     = 1)
```

## 3. HTO signal pair plots

```{r hto-data}
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(get0("DM2_AVAILABLE"))
hto_df             <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(
  SeuratObject::LayerData(srt, assay = "HTO", layer = "data"))))
hto_df$dm2_class   <- srt$dm2_class
hto_df$sample.name <- srt$sample.name
pairs              <- combn(hto_features, 2, simplify = FALSE)
```

### Coloured by assignment

```{r hto-pairs-class}
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(get0("DM2_AVAILABLE"))
#| fig-width: 10
plots <- list()
for (pr in pairs) {
  pr_key      <- paste(pr, collapse = "_vs_")
  plots[[pr_key]] <- ggplot(hto_df[sample(nrow(hto_df)), ],
         aes(x = .data[[pr[1]]], y = .data[[pr[2]]], colour = dm2_class)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.2, alpha = 0.4) +
    labs(title = paste(pr[1], "vs", pr[2])) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4))) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 7))
}
(wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 3) + plot_layout(guides = "collect")) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

### Coloured by sample


### Coloured by density

```{r hto-pairs-density}
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(get0("DM2_AVAILABLE"))
#| fig-width: 10

for (pr in pairs) {
  pr_key           <- paste(pr, collapse = "_vs_")
```

## 4. deMULTIplex2 assignment summary

```{r dm2-summary}
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(get0("DM2_AVAILABLE"))
dm2_tbl <- srt@meta.data |>
  dplyr::count(dm2_class, name = "n_cells") |>
  dplyr::mutate(pct = round(100 * n_cells / sum(n_cells), 1)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_cells))

knitr::kable(dm2_tbl, col.names = c("Class", "# cells", "% cells"))

ggplot(dm2_tbl, aes(x = reorder(dm2_class, -n_cells), y = n_cells,
                    fill = dm2_class)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.85, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(pct, "%")), vjust = -0.4, size = 3) +
  labs(title = "deMULTIplex2 class distribution (pre-QC)",
       x = NULL, y = "# cells") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
```

## 5. HTODemux — Seurat built-in demultiplexing

Run HTODemux on the same object for comparison with deMULTIplex2.

```{r htodemux}
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(get0("DM2_AVAILABLE"))
# ── Edit positive quantile ─────────────────────────────────────────
POSITIVE_QUANTILE <- qc_params$hto_demux_positive_quantile  # e.g. 0.99
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
srt <- Seurat::HTODemux(srt,
                         assay             = "HTO",
                         positive.quantile = POSITIVE_QUANTILE,
                         verbose           = FALSE)
```

### HTODemux assignment summary

```{r htodemux-summary}
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(get0("DM2_AVAILABLE"))
hto_tbl <- srt@meta.data |>
  dplyr::count(HTO_classification.global, name = "n_cells") |>
  dplyr::mutate(pct = round(100 * n_cells / sum(n_cells), 1)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_cells))

knitr::kable(hto_tbl,
             col.names = c("HTODemux class", "# cells", "% cells"))

ggplot(hto_tbl,
       aes(x = reorder(HTO_classification.global, -n_cells), y = n_cells,
           fill = HTO_classification.global)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.85, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(pct, "%")), vjust = -0.4, size = 3) +
  labs(title = paste0("HTODemux class distribution (quantile = ",
                      POSITIVE_QUANTILE, ")"),
       x = NULL, y = "# cells") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
```

## 6. HTODemux vs deMULTIplex2 — assignment comparison

The core comparison: how do the two tools assign individual HTOs?
`dm2_class` (deMULTIplex2) vs `HTO_classification` (HTODemux per-HTO label).
Diagonal = agreement; off-diagonal = discordant assignments.

```{r tool-comparison}
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(get0("DM2_AVAILABLE"))
# Full cross-table: dm2_class rows × HTODemux per-HTO assignment columns
comp_tbl <- srt@meta.data |>
  dplyr::count(dm2_class, HTO_classification, name = "n_cells") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from  = HTO_classification,
                     values_from = n_cells,
                     values_fill = 0L) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dm2_class)

knitr::kable(comp_tbl, caption = "Rows = deMULTIplex2, Cols = HTODemux (per-HTO label)")
```

```{r tool-comparison-tile}
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(get0("DM2_AVAILABLE"))
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8
comp_long <- srt@meta.data |>
  dplyr::count(dm2_class, HTO_classification, name = "n_cells")

# order axes: singlet HTOs first, then multiplet/negative
hto_order_dm2 <- c(sort(hto_features), setdiff(sort(unique(srt$dm2_class)), hto_features))
hto_order_htd <- c(sort(hto_features),
                   setdiff(sort(unique(srt$HTO_classification)), hto_features))

comp_long <- comp_long |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dm2_class          = factor(dm2_class,          levels = rev(hto_order_dm2)),
    HTO_classification = factor(HTO_classification, levels = hto_order_htd)
  )

ggplot(comp_long,
       aes(x = HTO_classification, y = dm2_class, fill = n_cells)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "grey80") +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(n_cells > 0, n_cells, "")), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "steelblue", name = "# cells",
                      trans = "sqrt") +
  labs(title    = "Assignment agreement: deMULTIplex2 (rows) vs HTODemux (cols)",
       subtitle = "Diagonal = concordant assignments",
       x        = "HTODemux",
       y        = "deMULTIplex2") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid  = element_blank())
```

### Global class agreement

Collapsed to Singlet / Doublet / Negative for a quick overall rate.

```{r tool-comparison-global}
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(get0("DM2_AVAILABLE"))
global_tbl <- srt@meta.data |>
  dplyr::count(dm2_class_global = dplyr::case_when(
                 dm2_class %in% hto_features ~ "Singlet",
                 dm2_class == "multiplet"    ~ "Doublet",
                 TRUE                         ~ "Negative"),
               HTO_classification.global,
               name = "n_cells") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from  = HTO_classification.global,
                     values_from = n_cells,
                     values_fill = 0L)

knitr::kable(global_tbl,
             caption = "Global class agreement — Rows: deMULTIplex2, Cols: HTODemux")
```

## 7. HTO signal heatmap by assignment class

Average CLR-normalised HTO signal per assignment class for both tools.

```{r hto-heatmap}
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(get0("DM2_AVAILABLE"))
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5
make_heatmap <- function(srt, group_by, title) {
  avg    <- Seurat::AverageExpression(srt, assay = "HTO",
                                       layer    = "data",
                                       group.by = group_by)$HTO
  avg_df <- as.data.frame(avg) |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("HTO") |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-HTO, names_to = "class", values_to = "avg_clr")
  ggplot(avg_df, aes(x = class, y = HTO, fill = avg_clr)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = round(avg_clr, 2)), size = 3) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "steelblue", mid = "white", high = "firebrick",
                         midpoint = 0, name = "Avg CLR") +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
}

make_heatmap(srt, "dm2_class",          "deMULTIplex2") |
make_heatmap(srt, "HTO_classification", "HTODemux")
```

---

## 8. HTO UMAP — coloured by both tools

UMAP run directly on CLR-normalised HTO features (no PCA intermediate).
Labels placed at cluster centroids; legends removed to save space.

```{r hto-umap-params}
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(get0("DM2_AVAILABLE"))
# ── Tune these if separation is poor ──────────────────────────
N_NEIGHBORS <- 20L
MIN_DIST    <- 0.3
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```

```{r hto-umap-compute}
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(get0("DM2_AVAILABLE"))
srt_sub <- Seurat::ScaleData(srt, assay = "HTO",
                              features = hto_features, verbose = FALSE)
srt_sub <- Seurat::RunUMAP(srt_sub,
                            features       = hto_features,
                            assay          = "HTO",
                            reduction.name = "umap.HTO",
                            n.neighbors    = N_NEIGHBORS,
                            min.dist       = MIN_DIST,
                            verbose        = FALSE)

# helper: scatter with centroid labels, no legend
labeled_dimplot <- function(srt, group_by, title) {
  emb <- as.data.frame(Seurat::Embeddings(srt, "umap.HTO"))
  colnames(emb) <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")
  emb[[group_by]] <- srt@meta.data[[group_by]]
  centroids <- emb |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data[[group_by]]) |>
    dplyr::summarise(UMAP_1 = median(UMAP_1), UMAP_2 = median(UMAP_2),
                     .groups = "drop")
  ggplot(emb[sample(nrow(emb)), ],
         aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, colour = .data[[group_by]])) +
    geom_point(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.5) +
    ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
      data          = centroids,
      aes(label     = .data[[group_by]]),
      size          = 3.5,
      label.padding = unit(0.15, "lines"),
      show.legend   = FALSE,
      seed          = 42
    ) +
    labs(title = title, x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}
```

### deMULTIplex2

```{r hto-umap-dm2}
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(get0("DM2_AVAILABLE"))
labeled_dimplot(srt_sub, "dm2_class", "deMULTIplex2")
```

### HTODemux

```{r hto-umap-htodemux}
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(get0("DM2_AVAILABLE"))
labeled_dimplot(srt_sub, "HTO_classification", "HTODemux")
```

